verdict.rationale: The firm's EC&VC team supports companies 'from incorporation through to exit', and it publishes free UK and DE cap table templates. Its incentives practice covers EMI options and growth shares. Together these touch on day-zero ownership structuring, but none of the evidence shows founder-specific materials. Missing for 10: founder vesting schedules or reverse vesting, 83(b) elections or the local UK/DE equivalent, co-founder equity split guidance, and any independent corroboration.
